title: Borel measurable differential on one antilipschitz C¹ chart, G(x) = D(f∘Φ)(Ψx)∘Λ(DΦ(Ψx))
statement: Let P, Q, n ∈ ℕ and let Λ : L(ℝⁿ, ℝ^P) → L(ℝ^P, ℝⁿ) be continuous on I := {A : A injective} with Λ(A)∘A = id_{ℝⁿ} and |A(Λ(A)v)| ≤ |v| for every A ∈ I and v ∈ ℝ^P. Let Ω ⊆ ℝⁿ be open, Φ : ℝⁿ → ℝ^P a C¹ map with c|w − w′| ≤ |Φ(w) − Φ(w′)| for all w, w′ ∈ Ω and some c > 0, and f : ℝ^P → ℝ^Q any map. Then there is a Borel measurable G : ℝ^P → L(ℝ^P, ℝ^Q) such that Φ(Ω) is a Borel set and every x ∈ Φ(Ω) admits w ∈ Ω with Φ(w) = x, G(x)(DΦ(w)s) = D(f∘Φ)(w)s for all s ∈ ℝⁿ, and for every v ∈ ℝ^P some s ∈ ℝⁿ with |DΦ(w)s| ≤ |v| and G(x)v = D(f∘Φ)(w)s (DΦ(w) = fderiv ℝ Φ w, D(f∘Φ)(w) = fderiv ℝ (f ∘ Φ) w, which is 0 where f∘Φ is not differentiable).
lean_statement: ∀ (P Q n : ℕ) (Λ : (Eucl n →L[ℝ] Eucl P) → (Eucl P →L[ℝ] Eucl n)) (Φ : Eucl n → Eucl P) (Ω : Set (Eucl n)) (f : Eucl P → Eucl Q), ContinuousOn Λ {A : Eucl n →L[ℝ] Eucl P | Function.Injective A} → (∀ A : Eucl n →L[ℝ] Eucl P, Function.Injective A → (Λ A).comp A = ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (Eucl n) ∧ ∀ v : Eucl P, ‖A (Λ A v)‖ ≤ ‖v‖) → IsOpen Ω → ContDiff ℝ 1 Φ → (∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ w ∈ Ω, ∀ w' ∈ Ω, c * ‖w - w'‖ ≤ ‖Φ w - Φ w'‖) → ∃ G : Eucl P → (Eucl P →L[ℝ] Eucl Q), Measurable G ∧ MeasurableSet (Φ '' Ω) ∧ ∀ x ∈ Φ '' Ω, ∃ w ∈ Ω, Φ w = x ∧ (∀ s : Eucl n, G x (fderiv ℝ Φ w s) = fderiv ℝ (f ∘ Φ) w s) ∧ ∀ v : Eucl P, ∃ s : Eucl n, ‖fderiv ℝ Φ w s‖ ≤ ‖v‖ ∧ G x v = fderiv ℝ (f ∘ Φ) w s
